mechanism: Disulfiram may inhibit the metabolism of furosemide and increase loop diuretic-induced hypokalemia and hyponatremia, particularly problematic in patients with alcohol use disorder on disulfiram maintenance therapy.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (potassium, sodium) regularly; consider potassium-sparing diuretic co-therapy or potassium supplementation; monitor for signs of dehydration and orthostatic hypotension.
